notes.title: GOOD LUCK BABY!, Noodletub's new yuri visual novel, now LIVE on KICKSTARTER!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, and thank you so much for playing THE GHOST OF YOU! We truly appreciate all of the love and support we've received since the game's release, and we truly hope that everyone has enjoyed their time with our eclectic cast of girls. 

[b][h1][url=https://kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel]We're posting an update today to announce our third big yuri project: GOOD LUCK BABY![/url][/h1][/b]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel][img]https://i.imgur.com/OaVv2cx.png[/img][/url]

The story revolves around our two leading girls – Hifumi Tanaka and Kasumi Itou – unravelling the mysteries behind the sudden appearance of a baby with wings, a halo, and strange powers on their doorstep. The mystery runs deeper than they could ever imagine, with the fate of the world itself resting in this tiny baby's hands. What is their role in this path fate has sent them down, and just who is the ruthless villain trying to snatch the baby away at any cost?

Much like our other projects, GOOD LUCK BABY! Is a yuri visual novel that includes mystery, drama, and girls falling in love amidst an unbelievable situation. If funding proves to be extra successful, it will launch with three fully realized routes – each of which features a focus on different characters, an original story, and tons of yuri! This is a story we here at Noodletub have been working on for a long time now, and we're so happy to finally unveil it to the world. 

But it needs your help! Without the generous pledges of Kickstarter backers, we won't be able to fund the project. All Kickstarter backers who pledge to get a copy of GOOD LUCK BABY! Will receive it at a sweet discount, as it will launch on Steam and itch.io at a higher price once released. If funded, the game will launch on Steam and itch.io for PC.

[h1][url=https://kickstarter.com/projects/noodletub/good-luck-baby-a-yuri-visual-novel]Check out the Kickstarter page for more information, and help us bring this project to life. Thank you so much for the support![/url][/h1]
